text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's the final G1 race of spring—the Takarazuka Kinen! Which one of these fine competitors will cross the finish line first?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Each and every one of these Umamusume carry the hopes of their fans on their shoulders… and here they come to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The venue for the Takarazuka Kinen is the Hanshin Racecourse, as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have a final meeting in the waiting room to wrap up some loose ends before the race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's go over some things. Were you able to get data on the other runners, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excellent. Let's look over them while we—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, not at all. This is… amazing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You even have data on their training methods here. Looking at this, it seems like it will be an intense race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, the runner-up of the pre-race favorite poll will likely pull away at the third turn, so I should be ready by the second turn. And…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The data I collected prove helpful, and we have a very productive meeting together.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Give it up for the grand winner of our pre-race favorite poll!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's right! And I'm about to prove to everyone who voted for me that they picked the winning racer!
